name: KaribuFans
site_url_note: The live address, without a trailing slash. Used for link previews (WhatsApp, Facebook, X) and canonical links. Change it here when a custom domain is added.
name_note: Working name. Change it here and rebuild; every page picks it up.
mode_note: everyday = Nairobi residents (default). tournament = visiting fans, switch on nearer June 2027.

tournament.dates_note: Reported as 19 June – 17 July 2027; confirm with CAF before showing on the site

disclaimer: KaribuFans is an independent city guide. It is not affiliated with CAF, the tournament organisers, Uber or Bolt. Photographs are by the photographers credited with each one, via Unsplash, and are for illustration only.
contact_whatsapp_note: KaribuFans business WhatsApp number (0792 637085), international format without + . The list-your-business, claim-a-listing and ticket alert forms open WhatsApp with a message to this number.
uber_client_id_note: Uber's developer docs list client_id as required for ride links. Register free at developer.uber.com and paste it here.
copyright_note: Shown in the footer. Replace with the registered business name once the registrar issues it.
contact_email_note: Shown on the privacy page as the contact for data questions and listing removals.
languages_note: Set live to true for a language only when its translation is published.
accounts_note: Visitor accounts (sign in, saved places). live: false keeps them hidden from the public; open any page with ?preview=accounts to switch them on in your own browser, and ?preview=off to hide them again. Set live to true to open them to everyone. supabase_url and supabase_key are the project address and the publishable key from Supabase; both are meant to be public. Never paste a secret or service_role key here. methods lists the sign-in options shown on the account page: google, email, or both. Email is left out for now (9 Oct 2026) because the Supabase project has no custom email sending (SMTP) set up and can send only two sign-in emails an hour; add "email" back once custom SMTP is on, and update templates/privacy_accounts.html to match.
